description.zh:
是否自动替换签名重试（默认开启），可取值：

- 1 开启自动重试功能，开启后，在验证码有效期内，当运营商返回明确的失败状态时，允许阿里云尽可能的尝试使用其他方式发送验证码，以提升发送成功率。其他方式包括且不限于：通过其他运营商重试、更换签名重试等

- 0 不开启自动重试
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically retry with an alternative signature. This feature is enabled by default. Valid values:

- 1: Enables automatic retry. When enabled, if the carrier returns an explicit failure status within the verification code validity period, Alibaba Cloud attempts to resend the verification code through alternative methods to improve the delivery success rate. Alternative methods include but are not limited to retrying through a different carrier or using a different signature.

- 0: Disables automatic retry.

description.zh: 验证码长度支持4～8位长度，默认是4位。
description.en: The length of the verification code. Valid values: 4 to 8. Default value: 4.

description.zh:
生成的验证码类型。当参数TemplateParam传入占位符时，此参数必填，将由系统根据指定的规则生成验证码。取值：
- 1：纯数字（默认）。
- 2：纯大写字母。
- 3：纯小写字母。
- 4：大小字母混合。
- 5：数字+大写字母混合。
- 6：数字+小写字母混合。
- 7：数字+大小写字母混合。
description.en:
The type of the verification code to generate. This parameter is required when the TemplateParam parameter contains a placeholder. The system generates a verification code based on the specified rule. Valid values:
- 1: digits only (default).
- 2: uppercase letters only.
- 3: lowercase letters only.
- 4: mixed uppercase and lowercase letters.
- 5: digits and uppercase letters.
- 6: digits and lowercase letters.
- 7: digits, uppercase letters, and lowercase letters.

description.zh: 号码国家编码。默认为86，目前也仅支持国内号码发送。
description.en: The country code of the phone number. Default value: 86. Currently, only phone numbers in the Chinese mainland are supported.

description.zh:
核验规则，当有效时间内对同场景内的同号码重复发送验证码时，旧验证码如何处理。

- 1：覆盖处理（默认），即旧验证码会失效掉。

- 2：保留，即多个验证码都是在有效期内都可以校验通过。
description.en:
The verification rule that specifies how to handle old verification codes when a new verification code is sent to the same phone number within the same scenario during the validity period. Valid values:

- 1: Override (default). The old verification code is invalidated.

- 2: Retain. Multiple verification codes are valid and can pass verification within the validity period.

description.zh: 时间间隔，单位：秒。即多久间隔可以发送一次验证码，用于频控，默认60秒。
description.en: The minimum interval between two consecutive verification code deliveries. Unit: seconds. This parameter is used for frequency control. Default value: 60.
The phone number of the SMS recipient.

description.zh:
是否返回验证码。取值：
- **true**：返回。
- **false**：不返回。
description.en:
Specifies whether to return the verification code. Valid values:
- **true**: Returns the verification code.
- **false**: Does not return the verification code.

description.zh: 方案名称，如果不填则为“默认方案”。最多不超过20个字符。
description.en: The scheme name. If this parameter is not specified, the value defaults to "Default Scheme". The value can be up to 20 characters in length.

description.zh: 签名名称。暂不支持使用自定义签名，请使用系统赠送的签名，您可在[赠送签名配置](https://dypns.console.aliyun.com/smsCertParamsConfig/sign)页面选择需要下发的签名。
description.en: The signature name. Custom signatures are not supported. Use the system-provided signature. You can select the signature to use on the [Complimentary Signature Configuration](https://dypns.console.aliyun.com/smsCertParamsConfig/sign) page.

description.zh:
上行短信扩展码。上行短信指发送给通信服务提供商的短信，用于定制某种服务、完成查询，或是办理某种业务等，需要收费，按运营商普通短信资费进行扣费。

>扩展码是生成签名时系统自动默认生成的，不支持自行传入。无特殊需要此字段的用户请忽略此字段。如需使用，请联系您的商务经理。
description.en:
The uplink SMS extension code. Uplink SMS messages are messages sent to a telecommunications service provider to subscribe to a service, complete a query, or handle a transaction. Uplink SMS messages are charged at the standard SMS rate of the carrier.

> The extension code is automatically generated by the system when the signature is created and cannot be manually specified. Ignore this parameter unless you have specific requirements. To use this parameter, contact your account manager.

description.zh: 短信模板CODE。参数`SignName`选择赠送签名时，必须搭配赠送模板下发短信。您可在[赠送模板配置](https://dypns.console.aliyun.com/smsCertParamsConfig/template)页面选择适用您业务场景的模板。
description.en: The SMS template code. When the SignName parameter is set to a system-provided signature, a system-provided template must be used. You can select a template that fits your business scenario on the [Complimentary Template Configuration](https://dypns.console.aliyun.com/smsCertParamsConfig/template) page.

description.zh:
短信模板参数。验证码位置有两种传值方式：

- 可使用"##code##"替代，由参数CodeType指定验证码生成规则；
- 也可直接传入具体的验证码值，直接下发至接收方。

示例：如模板内容为：“您的验证码是${code}，有效期${min}分钟，请勿告诉他人。”。
<notice>上文中的code请替换成您实际申请的验证码模板中的参数名称</notice>
- 该字段可传入`{"code":"##code##","min":"5"}`由系统根据规则生成验证码；

- 或直接传入指定的验证码值`{"code":"123456","min":"5"}`。

> - {"code":"##code##","min":"5"}验证码是api动态生成的，阿里云接口可以完成校验。
> - {"code":"123456","min":"5"}验证码是用户配置的不是api动态生成，阿里云接口无法校验。

> - 如果JSON中需要带换行符，请参照标准的JSON协议处理。
> - 模板变量规范，请参见[短信模板规范](~~108253~~)。
description.en:
The SMS template parameters. You can pass the verification code in two ways:

- Use "##code##" as a placeholder, and specify the CodeType parameter to define the verification code generation rule.
- Pass a specific verification code value directly, which is sent to the recipient as-is.

Example: If the template content is "Your verification code is ${code}, valid for ${min} minutes. Do not share it with anyone."
<notice>Replace "code" in the example above with the actual parameter name in your verification code template.</notice>
- You can pass `{"code":"##code##","min":"5"}` to let the system generate a verification code based on the specified rule.

- Or pass a specific verification code value directly: `{"code":"123456","min":"5"}`.

> - {"code":"##code##","min":"5"}: The verification code is dynamically generated by the API, and the Alibaba Cloud API can perform verification.
> - {"code":"123456","min":"5"}: The verification code is user-specified and not dynamically generated by the API. The Alibaba Cloud API cannot perform verification.

> - If the JSON string contains line breaks, handle them in accordance with the standard JSON protocol.
> - For template variable specifications, see [SMS template specifications](~~108253~~).

description.zh: 验证码有效时长，单位秒，默认为300秒。
description.en: The validity period of the verification code. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300.

descriptions.zh:
- 由于运营商近期加强对短信签名的管控。您自定义的签名面临下发失败问题，推荐您使用号码认证控制台赠送的短信签名和模板进行短信认证。系统赠送签名必须搭配系统赠送模板使用。
- 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解号码认证服务产品的收费方式和[价格](~~85132~~)，短信认证服务仅收取短信发送费用（按运营商回执状态计费，短信提交成功但运营商回执失败时不计费），核验服务免费。
descriptions.en:
- Due to recent tightening of SMS signature regulations by carriers, custom signatures may fail to be delivered. Use the SMS signatures and templates provided free of charge in the Phone  Number Verification Service console for SMS verification. System-provided signatures must be used with system-provided templates.
- Before using this operation, make sure that you fully understand the billing method and [pricing](~~85132~~) of Phone  Number Verification Service. SMS verification is charged only for SMS sending (billed based on the carrier receipt status. No fee is charged if the SMS is committed successfully but the carrier returns a failed receipt). The verification service is free of charge.
